items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open and close under their headings, one at a time or independently.

items.name: action-row
items.title: Action Row
items.description: The row of buttons and selects attached under a message.

items.name: ai-chat
items.title: AI chat
items.description: A conversation with an assistant: starter prompts, markdown replies, a typing state and the composer, composed from the registry.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline notice with an icon and a coloured edge, in info, success, warning and danger kinds.

items.name: app-invite
items.title: App Invite
items.description: The app directory card a link to an app unfurls into inside a message: cover banner, icon, name and a call to action.

items.name: app-launcher
items.title: App Launcher
items.description: The Apps launcher, as a desktop popout or a bottom sheet, with search, a recents strip and the apps installed in a server.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment Card
items.description: File card showing a type icon, file name, size and a download action.

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit Log
items.description: A list of who changed what and when, with entries that open to show each change.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A circular user avatar with image support and initials fallback in five sizes.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: A row of overlapping avatars with a count for the members not shown.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small pill used to label status, counts or categories.

items.name: bot-command-card
items.title: Bot Command Card
items.description: A card documenting a slash command, its owning bot and its typed options.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path from the top of a section to the current page, as a row of links.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Displays a Discord-styled button with brand, secondary, success, danger, link and icon variants.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking one day, with keyboard navigation and optional first and last selectable dates.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered, elevated panel for grouping related content.

items.name: channel-header
items.title: Channel Header
items.description: The bar above the message list, with the channel name, topic and channel actions.

items.name: channel-info
items.title: Channel Info
items.description: The channel detail panel that covers a channel on narrow screens.

items.name: channel-sidebar
items.title: Channel sidebar
items.description: The column a server is navigated from: its name, its channels as a tree and the user panel at the foot.

items.name: channel-topic
items.title: Channel Topic Bar
items.description: A header bar showing the channel name and a truncating topic description.

items.name: channel-welcome
items.title: Channel Welcome
items.description: The header that opens a channel, shown above its very first message.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: The channel shell: a scrolling message log with the composer pinned below it.

items.name: chat-window
items.title: Chat window
items.description: A whole channel view: header, scrolling message list and composer, composed from the registry.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: Several answers out of a visible list, each with an optional description.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A monospace preformatted block that colours its own source from a language name.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A palette of swatches with a custom colour tile, for role and accent colours.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A searchable quick switcher of grouped destinations and actions, driven from the keyboard.

items.name: command-panel
items.title: Command panel
items.description: A command browser with a selectable suggestion list and a detailed option card.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu that opens on a right click, with items, keyboard shortcuts, separators and a danger variant.

items.name: cooldown-bar
items.title: Cooldown Bar
items.description: A slim progress bar with a label and monospace countdown for command cooldowns.

items.name: custom-emoji
items.title: Custom Emoji
items.description: An uploaded emoji that sits on the text baseline and reads as :name:.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets the writing direction for a subtree and exposes it to the components that need to know which way is forward.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A horizontal rule with an optional centered label, spacing steps and a line-less mode.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A modal panel that slides against an edge of the screen and closes on Escape, overlay click or an explicit close control.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu that opens from a button, with icon, label and description items that highlight in brand color.

items.name: embed
items.title: Embed
items.description: A Discord-inspired rich message embed with an accent bar, author, title, description, fields, footer and timestamp.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A centered placeholder with an icon, title, and hint shown when a list or view has no content.

items.name: entity-select
items.title: Entity Select
items.description: The picker for a server's own members, roles and channels, with chips when more than one may be chosen.

items.name: expressions-picker
items.title: Expressions Picker
items.description: A Discord-inspired picker for Unicode emoji and caller-supplied stickers and GIFs.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A drop zone that also opens a file picker from the keyboard.

items.name: form-fields
items.title: Form Fields
items.description: Inputs, textareas, selects, labels, helper text, switches and checkboxes styled for the newt/ui dark theme.

items.name: inline-code
items.title: Inline Code
items.description: A monospace pill for code inside a line of message text.

items.name: invite
items.title: Invite
items.description: The server invite card a link unfurls into inside a message.

items.name: kbd-tag
items.title: Keyboard Shortcut Tag
items.description: A small monospace tag for displaying keyboard shortcuts.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Renders a message written in chat markdown — formatting, mentions, timestamps, spoilers, code blocks — with the library's own parts.

items.name: media-gallery
items.title: Media Gallery
items.description: One to ten images in a mosaic, laid out by how many there are.

items.name: member-list
items.title: Member List
items.description: A server member sidebar: role sections, presence, coloured names and APP tags.

items.name: mention
items.title: Mention Chip
items.description: An inline chip for user, channel, role and app mentions, with an optional avatar.

items.name: message-composer
items.title: Message Composer
items.description: The channel input bar: attachment control, text field with combobox hooks, and send.

items.name: message-group
items.title: Message Group
items.description: A grouped chat message with author, timestamp, reply preview, reactions and an ephemeral state.

items.name: message-list
items.title: Message List
items.description: The polite live region that logs grouped messages in a channel.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: A centered dialog over a dimmed overlay that closes on Escape, overlay click or an explicit close control.

items.name: notif-badge
items.title: Notification Badge
items.description: A small count badge or unread dot for signalling new activity on avatars and channels.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A number field with decrement and increment buttons that respect min, max and step.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A short setup flow: a stepper, the current step's content and the buttons that move through it.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbered page buttons with previous/next controls, plus a divider-style load-more row.

items.name: permission
items.title: Permission Row
items.description: A settings row with a deny / inherit / allow tri-state toggle.

items.name: pin-input
items.title: Pin Input
items.description: A short code entered one character to a box, for two-factor and verification codes.

items.name: poll
items.title: Poll
items.description: A question, its answers, and the share of the vote behind each one.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel anchored to the button that opens it, closed by Escape or a press outside.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: A gradient progress bar for boosts, uploads and other long-running tasks.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: One choice out of a short, visible list, with the ring and dot the client's settings panels use.

items.name: reaction
items.title: Reaction Pill
items.description: A toggleable emoji reaction pill, plus the group that rows them under a message.

items.name: reply-preview
items.title: Reply Preview
items.description: A compact "replying to" bar showing the author, a truncated excerpt, or the slash command that was used.

items.name: role-tag
items.title: Role Tag
items.description: A compact bordered tag with a coloured dot for displaying a member's role.

items.name: scrollbar
items.title: Scrollbar Utility
items.description: Discord-styled scrollbars for any scrollable container, with an overlay thumb, auto-hide and an optional keyboard-focusable viewport.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A block of text with one accessory beside it — a thumbnail, or a button.

items.name: select-menu
items.title: Select Menu
items.description: A Discord-inspired string select: combobox trigger, keyboard-driven listbox and a portalled panel.

items.name: server-banner
items.title: Server Banner
items.description: Invite-style card with a server icon, name, live member counts and a join button.

items.name: server-sidebar
items.title: Server sidebar
items.description: The column beside a channel: the server banner, the voice channel and the grouped member list.

items.name: settings-layout
items.title: Settings layout
items.description: A settings screen: grouped sections down the side and the chosen section's breadcrumb, heading and content beside them.

items.name: side-nav
items.title: Side Nav
items.description: A vertical list of grouped links for the sections of a settings screen.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton Loader
items.description: A shimmering placeholder shown while content is loading.

items.name: slash-command
items.title: Slash Command
items.description: An inline /command with its subcommand path and typed options, including the focused one.

items.name: slash-command-suggestions
items.title: Slash Command Suggestions
items.description: The command picker that opens above the composer, with an app rail, grouped options and a matched-command preview.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range control with a filled track, a grabber and optional labelled marks, for volumes and thresholds.

items.name: spoiler
items.title: Spoiler
items.description: Inline text hidden behind a solid block until the reader clicks to reveal it.

items.name: stage-banner
items.title: Stage Banner
items.description: A full-width announcement strip with a status dot, optional action button and dismiss control.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: A presence dot anchored to an avatar, with online, idle, do-not-disturb, offline and streaming states.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a fixed sequence of steps, horizontal or stacked.

items.name: system-message
items.title: System Message
items.description: The lines a channel writes about itself — joins, boosts, pins — with no author and no avatar.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A bordered data table with sortable headings, selectable rows and a caption.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A pill-style tab list that switches the active tab on click.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A text field that keeps what was typed as removable chips.

items.name: text-display
items.title: Text Display
items.description: A block of message text that keeps its line breaks, with the chat markdown heading and subtext sizes.

items.name: thread-preview
items.title: Thread Preview
items.description: The thread hanging off a message: its name, its reply count and the last thing said.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Event Timeline
items.description: A vertical event log with connected status dots, titles and metadata.

items.name: timestamp
items.title: Timestamp
items.description: One instant, written in the reader's own locale and time zone.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A transient notification with a status icon that auto-dismisses after a timeout or when closed.

items.name: token-field
items.title: Token Field
items.description: A read-only, masked monospace input with reveal and copy-to-clipboard actions for secrets such as bot tokens.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small floating label that appears above an element on hover or focus.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A collapsible, keyboard-driven list of nested rows, such as categories and their channels.

items.name: typeset
items.title: Typeset
items.description: Styles the HTML a markdown renderer emits — CommonMark and GFM — with three variables: size, leading and flow.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: Three bouncing dots with a label that signals someone is typing.

items.name: user-panel
items.title: User Panel
items.description: The strip at the foot of a sidebar: the signed-in user and their mute, deafen and settings controls.

items.name: user-profile
items.title: User Profile Popout
items.description: Floating profile card with a banner, overlapping avatar, bio section and role tags.

items.name: v2-container
items.title: V2 Container
items.description: The Components V2 block that groups text, separators and action rows behind one accent bar.

items.name: voice-channel
items.title: Voice Channel Row
items.description: A sidebar voice channel row with a collapsible header and the list of connected members.

items.name: theme-newt
items.title: newt/ui theme
items.description: The Discord-inspired --newt-* design tokens, for Tailwind v3 and v4.
